description: Several labels in one cell, with the ones that do not fit counted rather than wrapped: a wall of pills makes every row a different height and the column unreadable. The overflow says how many are left and names them on hover. The twin of `AvatarGroup`, which does the same for faces.

props.name: items
props.description: Every label on the record, in the order it should be read.

props.name: max
props.description: How many are shown before the overflow. Two in a table cell, more in a panel where the row height is not shared with two hundred other rows.
